title: Sunflower Warrior Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a female anime-style character with spiky black hair, sunflower goggles, and a yellow-black outfit featuring a corset, short pleated skirt, and thigh-high patterned stockings. She holds a katana in the first pose, runs with motion lines in the second, stands with a large sunflower and black splatter effect in the third, and poses confidently with a sunflower on her hip in the fourth. All against a solid bright green background with vertical dividing lines.
prompt: A character turnaround sheet on a solid lime green background showing four distinct poses of the same anime girl. She has wild spiky black hair, wears large sunflower-shaped goggles, a yellow and black corset top with a short pleated yellow skirt, black thigh-high stockings with circular patterns, and yellow combat boots. She has a black tail. In the first panel she holds a katana ready to fight, second panel she is running forward dynamically, third panel she stands holding a giant sunflower with black ink splatter behind it, fourth panel she poses with a sunflower tucked into her belt. Vibrant colors, cel-shaded anime style.
